title: ROS1 vs ROS2 Mapping Comparison
description: Experiment pipeline, metrics and analysis tools for a practical, system-level comparison of ROS1 and ROS2 mapping pipelines on a real mobile robot: identical slam_toolbox parameters on both stacks, bag replay, per-process resources, latency, ATE/RPE and map accuracy, ROS2 middleware (Fast DDS, Cyclone DDS, Zenoh) and distribution (Humble, Jazzy) comparisons.
